value: Instructions must be of an allowed type
note: Diagnostic-quality issue: the reported symptom IS the DXIL validator diagnostic quoted in the issue body verbatim ("Instructions must be of an allowed type", at an `insertvalue ... %dx.types.fouri32` note). Anchored on the diagnostic text rather than on exit code alone: the process exit is ordinary E_FAIL (0x80004005), identical to any other diagnosed validation failure, so an exit-code-only predicate cannot discriminate this from an unrelated compile error. Because this predicate's own positive clause quotes the validator's message verbatim, `classify` does not treat a match here as an invalid-probe demotion (see SKILL.md 'markers break down on an issue whose reported symptom IS a diagnostic'). Confirmed via control-scalar.hlsl (a scalar, non-vector WaveMatch argument) that the predicate does not fire on an unrelated clean compile under the same -Od -Zi flags.
